gdpr.export: Where you're up to in each book, show and game, and the spoilers you chose to reveal.
gdpr.delete: Your places and reveals are deleted. Books, shows and games you added stay, without your name.

api.invalid_work: That book, show or game doesn't exist.
api.invalid_position: That spot isn't on the list for this book, show or game.
api.invalid_quote_other_work: This reply already has spoilers for one book, show or game, so it can't also quote spoilers from another. Post that quote in a reply of its own.

veil.guest: Log in and say how far you've got, and anything you've reached opens up.
veil.set_progress: Tell us how far you've got
veil.offer: You finished this in your collection: unlock everything

mark.title: Spoilers up to here in {work}
mark.discussion_help: How far into it does this discussion go? Members who haven't got that far see it blurred.
mark.reply_help: Replies go up to where you are in {work}, so people who aren't that far see them blurred. Pick another spot if your reply doesn't need it.
mark.search: Find a book, show or game
mark.define: Add a book, show or game

ladder.no_point: Just talks about it, no spoilers
ladder.chapters_auto: This series keeps track for you: every chapter you open counts as read.
ladder.finished_only: This one is all or nothing: you've either finished it or you haven't.

progress.title: Where are you in {work}?
progress.help: Anything up to here opens for you. Anything further along stays blurred until you get there, or tap to reveal it.
progress.offer: Your collection says you've finished this one.
progress.finished_now: You've finished it, so everything is open.

sidebar.not_set: You haven't said how far you've got.

page.title: Spoiler progress
page.intro: Say how far you've got in a book, show or game, and discussions further along stay blurred until you catch up.
page.guest: Log in to keep track of where you are.
page.mine_empty: You haven't set your place in anything yet. Pick something below.
page.cannot_edit: Only whoever added it, or a moderator, can change this one.

work.new_title: Add a book, show or game
work.title: Title
work.steps_help: One per line: chapters, episodes, levels, rounds. Add new ones at the end; a part already in use can't be taken away.
work.catalog_help: To offer "finished: unlock everything" to members who finished it in their collection, for example openlibrary:OL45883W or igdb:1942.
work.tags_help: New discussions in these tags belong to this one.
work.delete_confirm: Delete this, and take its spoiler marks off every discussion?

error.invalid_steps: Add at least one part (up to 500).
error.invalid_catalog: The collection match looks like source:id, for example openlibrary:OL45883W.
error.steps_in_use: A part that discussions or members already use can't be taken away.
error.steps_reordered: Parts already in use can't change places. Rename them, or add new ones at the end.
error.work_in_use: Discussions and members already use this one, so only a moderator can delete it.

settings.blur: Blur anything with a spoiler mark
settings.members: Members who haven't said how far they've got
settings.members_help: Blurring is the safe choice; they can still tap to reveal one at a time.
settings.guests_help: Guests can't say how far they've got, so they see what you choose here.
settings.stamp_replies: Mark replies with their author's place
settings.stamp_replies_help: A reply in a discussion with a spoiler mark goes up to where its author is, so it's blurred for people who aren't that far. Authors can change it in the composer.

permissions.manage_works: Edit any book, show or game, and attach tags
